data.name: HELP_ALERTING_ON_CALLS_DELAY
data.value: Specifies value in seconds, used by the phone to delay the displaying of call popup and playing of ringtone for an incoming call. This parameter is only applied when Incoming Indication is Audible or Visual or Both. Indication delay equal to 0 means no delay. To use default value configured by an administrator, delete entered value using "Backspace" soft key.

data.name: HELP_ALERTING_ON_CALLS_INDICATION
data.value: Define the phone behavior for a shared line incoming call. None - phone will not display the incoming call screen and will not play a ringtone. Audible - phone will play a ringtone. Visual - phone will display the incoming call screen. Both - phone will display the incoming call screen and play a ringtone. Default - phone will use a value configured by an administrator. Actual value is displayed in brackets. In the case if Incoming Call Popup is disabled on the phone, enabling Visual indication will enable only Beacon Led indication. Administrator can disable changing this parameter.
